ocr.notes: boat leaves at 9 o'clock Tuesday morning, not 7; image reads 'Jem Mace Morris' (one name), not 'Jem Mace, Morris'

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that the Allen–Gallagher prize fight set for Tuesday stirred little excitement, with Allen the betting favorite and the steamboat Belle Ida chartered to carry spectators.

metadata.notes: masthead reads THE MISSOURI REPUBLICAN ST. LOUIS, OCTOBER 30, 1870

facts.fact: Allen's prize fight with Gallagher was set for Tuesday, with the steamboat Belle Ida chartered to carry spectators from the foot of Walnut street, St. Louis; Allen was the betting favorite
Jem Mace and Barney Aaron were named as Allen's seconds for the Gallagher fight

notes: Charley Gallagher is listed as one of Gallagher's seconds, so the opponent is a different Gallagher (James Cornelius Gallagher per article 039).
